evidence.evidence_text: We propose MEXMA, a novel approach that integrates both sentence-level and token-level objectives.
Our approach outperforms current pre-trained cross-lingual sentence encoders on bitext mining as well as several downstream tasks.
Cross-lingual sentence encoders (CLSE) create fixed-size sentence representations with aligned translations.
We propose MEXMA, a novel approach that integrates both sentence-level and token-level objectives.
The sentence representation in one language is used to predict masked tokens in another language, with both the sentence representation and all tokens directly update the encoder.
Current pre-trained CLSE approaches use sentence-level objectives only.
